description: Registers a domain for the registrant your user names. The answer gives the domain token (jdd_...) that manages it: Keep the domain token (jdd_) secret, and keep the payment proof you used (the l402 value or the cashu token): calling again with the same arguments and proof within 24 h shows the same token, and domain_token_recover with the proof replaces a lost token at any time. Paid, no account: without payment it answers payment_required with this order's price (valid 15 minutes), a Lightning invoice (L402) and a Cashu request, after every free check passed (no invoice otherwise). Pay only within what your user allowed, then call again with exactly the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or cashu='<token>' (a Cashu token is melted into the service's Lightning wallet at once; if the mint does not pay, the token stays yours). Free quote first: domain_check.

attestation.description: true only after your user confirmed: 'I am authorised by the named registrant to register this domain for them, and the registrant accepts the registration agreement' (https://satsdns.com/registration-agreement).

cashu.description: Cashu token (cashuA... or cashuB...) worth at least the price, from an accepted mint (see info). Pays without a previous call.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. example.com (an offered TLD: info, domains.tlds).

host_zone.description: Also host the zone here for a year (the hosting add-on); the answer then has a zone token (jdz_) too.

l402.description: Lightning payment proof for a retry: '<macaroon>:<preimage>', where macaroon comes from the payment_required answer of the previous call and preimage is the 64-hex proof your wallet returns after paying its invoice. Use it with the same tool and arguments.

nameservers.description: Your own nameservers (2-13 host names); leave out to use ours.

owner_npub.description: Optional Nostr key (npub1... or 64 hex) whose account owns the domain from payment on and gets expiry reminders. Without it the domain token alone manages the domain.

registrant.description: The registrant of record: the real person or organization your user is, never you and never placeholders. Required: name, email (must accept mail: the registrar asks to confirm it within 15 days), phone (+CC.NUMBER, e.g. +1.6045551234), address1, city, postal_code, country (ISO 3166 two letters). Optional: organization, address2, state.

name: domain_register
title: Register a domain, no account (live price in sats)
